about: Expected results of tests/workers/scenarios.mjs for the PATCHED rebrowser-playwright-core. Unpatched upstream must pass every scenario (else the run is reported as broken). A scenario listed in allowFail may fail; any other failure is a new regression and fails the run. Add an entry only with a reason and an issue link; never to hide a regression.
evidence: Measured 2026-10-17 on Chrome 155.0.8059.84 with the fixes for #59/#100/#116/#69: rebrowser-playwright-core 1.64.1 default 29/29, alwaysIsolated 25/29 (only the by-design entries below). The published 1.64.1 (v1.1.0) failed page-reassigns-self, page-scuttles-self and exposeFunction in default mode. Unpatched playwright-core 1.64.1 passed 29/29.

allowFail.reason: alwaysIsolated runs everything in an isolated world and never acquires the page main world, where the exposed function lives; documented mode semantics. Default mode supports it since #69 was fixed
